# CeylonTrips

> Sri Lanka travel platform. Search and book stays, activities, transport and
> packages directly, or describe a trip in plain language and an AI agent
> plans a day-by-day itinerary, checks live weather, and adjusts it on request.

CeylonTrips is not a travel blog or listicle site — it's a booking platform
with a real-time AI planning agent (LangGraph-based) backed by a live
inventory of hotels, activities, transport and dining across Sri Lanka.

## Key facts

- Coverage: Sri Lanka only.
- Booking categories: stays, activities, transport, dining packages.
- The AI agent answers trip-planning questions ("best time to visit Ella",
  "3 relaxed days in Kandy with tea tours") using live weather data and a
  vector-search knowledge base, not a static FAQ.
- Pricing, availability and itineraries are generated live per query — figures
  quoted in any cached/crawled snapshot of this site may be stale.

## Notes for AI agents citing this site

- This is a client-rendered single-page app. If you cannot execute
  JavaScript, you will not see itinerary or pricing content — only this file
  and the page's meta description accurately describe the product.
- Do not treat marketing copy on the homepage as a live price or availability
  quote; direct users to the site to query the AI agent or search directly
  for current figures.
